title: Spectral phase transitions in Gaussian multi-index models
summary: Recovering a low-dimensional latent subspace from nonlinear observations of Gaussian covariates in high dimensions is a fundamental problem in feature learning. Here, we consider Gaussian multi-index models in which the covariates $\boldsymbol{x}_i \stackrel{\mathrm{i.i.d.}}{\sim} \mathcal{N}(0,\boldsymbol{I}_d)$ and the responses $\boldsymbol{y}_i$ depend on $\boldsymbol{x}_i$ only through its projection onto an unknown $r$-dimensional subspace.
